title: SIDESTORY: SUCH IS THE JOY OF OUR REUNION RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: SUCH IS THE JOY OF OUR REUNION RERUN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: Such is the Joy of Our Reunion event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Flavor of Food] & [Flavor of Life] & [Farewell, Loved Ones]
[Baizao Cuisine & Food Culture]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Baizao Cuisine & Food Culture] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Xingzhu], Ding Feng Lou Teahouse Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, 'Yum-yum!', etc.
[Savors at Yu's]

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain ['Yum-yum!'] by clearing event stages and completing [Baizao Cuisine & Food Culture] missions. ['Yum-yum!'] can be used to redeem items from [Savors at Yu's].
REWARDS: Xingzhu's Tokens, Ding Feng Lou Teahouse Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.

- For this rerun event, some of the engraved medals in the corresponding Engraved Medal Set will have their acquisition conditions adjusted. Players who meet the updated conditions will be able to obtain the event's engraved medals. Due to these adjustments, players who previously participated in the event and already meet the new acquisition conditions will receive the corresponding engraved medals immediately upon the update.
- After this rerun event ends, the engraved medals from the event's Engraved Medal Set cannot be obtained again through [Score] or any other channels.
- This rerun event is a lightweight rerun; event stages will inherit the player's previous event stage progress and first-time drop progress.

- Some non-repeatable event rewards during this rerun can be converted into [Intelligence Certificate] at a corresponding ratio when obtained again. The conversion rates can be found in the event's Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules.
- The [Intelligence Certificate] shop will restock additional quantities of existing items and add new items when the event starts.
- Trust gain for Yu, Blaze the Igniting Spark, Surfer, and Xingzhu will be increased in the event stages of this rerun.
- After this event ends, the event stages will be permanently added to [Score] on July 20, 2026, at 04:00 (UTC-7).
02 GARDEN OF GROTESQUERIES LIMITED-TIME MISSION OPEN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: During the event, players can earn 'Strategist' Points by completing Daily Missions or participating in events. Accumulate a certain number of points to obtain rewards, such as the event icon.
REWARDS: Event Icon - 'Lingering Lotus', Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:
After the event ends, any excess points (above 4,500) will be converted into LMD at a rate of 1 point = 20 LMD and sent via mail.
03 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
EPOQUE Collection - Spring in Her Lens for Xingzhu
04 EPOQUE COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
EPOQUE Collection - Tons of Sunshine for Wanqing
